data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use Apple Vision Text Recognition in an image or live camera feed.
data.what_it_does: Enables Flutter apps to perform on-device text recognition using Apple's Vision framework. It supports processing static images and live camera feeds on iOS and macOS platforms.
use_when: You need native Apple Vision text recognition in a Flutter application for iOS or macOS.
You are processing live camera feeds or static images for text extraction on Apple platforms.
avoid_when: You need cross-platform text recognition that also supports Android, Windows, or Linux.
You prefer a maintained Google ML Kit alternative for non-Apple platforms.
strengths: Leverages native Apple Vision framework for high-performance on-device text recognition.
Supports both static images and live camera feeds.
weaknesses: Limited to iOS and macOS platforms only.
Not officially sponsored or maintained by Apple.
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum macOS deployment target 10.15, iOS 13.0, Xcode 13 or newer, and Swift 5.
data.minimal_example:
AppleVisionRecognizeTextController visionController = AppleVisionRecognizeTextController();
List<RecognizedText>? textData = await visionController.processImage(image, imageSize);
